$comment: Launch Control XL 3 DAW-mode control map. Transcribed from the official Programmer's Reference Guide v1.0, page 9 (see spec/reference/cc-map-decimal.png). Channels are 1-based as printed in the guide.
source: Novation Launch Control XL 3 Programmer's Reference Guide v1.0, p.9-10, p.17
verified: against official documentation; NOT yet against hardware capture

notes.ledAddressing: The same control index is used to colour that control's LED: B0h <index> <palette 0-127>. The official guide specifies channel 1 (B0h). Captures of Ableton Live 12 show it also emitting BFh (channel 16) for some indices - accept both on input.
notes.touchEvents: When enabled (CC 71 ch7), touch on/off is CC on channel 15 using the same control index, value 127 = on, 0 = off. Example: leftmost fader = BEh 05h 7Fh.
notes.shift: Shift is on channel 7 because it is bound to feature control 3Fh (63).
notes.mode: The Mode button emits nothing (n/a); it is a local UI button.

utilitySmallButton.$comment: unlabelled small button left of the top button row

relativeEncoding.$comment: 65 = one step clockwise, 63 = one step anticlockwise; further from pivot = faster

featureControls.$comment: Sent to the DAW In port on channel 7 to set; channel 8 to query; replies always on channel 7. (*) non-volatile, (#) always enabled in DAW mode.

113.name: temporaryDisplayTimeout
113.units: tenths of a second, minimum 1 second at 0

commands.0x09: bitmap: 09 <target> <1216 bytes> F7; device replies F0 00 20 29 02 15 09 7F

displayArrangements.1: 2 lines: parameter name + text value (2 fields)
displayArrangements.2: 3 lines: title, parameter name, text value (3 fields)
displayArrangements.4: 2 lines: parameter name + numeric value (default, 1 field)
displayArrangements.$bits: bit 6 = auto temporary display on change (default set); bit 5 = auto temporary display on touch (default set); bits 0-4 = arrangement id
